snippet.title: Train Civilians into Warriors in This Tactical SRPG! STRANGER SAGA – Class Introduction
snippet.description:
This is a class introduction video for the indie game STRANGER SAGA, now available.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3821860/STRANGER_SAGA/
https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ01385835.html

- "STRANGER SAGA" is a turn-based SRPG where you lead a resistance army against a mighty enemy force.
- The key to victory lies with the "Civilians"—ordinary people with extraordinary potential.
- Civilians start off weak but possess immense hidden abilities that unlock powerful combat skills as they grow.
- You are free to choose each Civilian's class path: Knight, Soldier, Scout, Barbarian, Archer, or Mage.
- Build the ultimate team of your own design!
